name: Metadata Agent
description: Development of an AI-driven Metadata Agent for intuitive access to data catalogs in Asset & Wealth Management.

purpose.description: To enable users within the Asset and Wealth Management organization seamless access to various data product catalogs using natural language queries.
objectives: Develop a Metadata Agent to improve discoverability of data products.
Integrate AI systems to read metadata and enhance query accuracy.

value.description: The project enhances user experience and efficiency in accessing data products by utilizing AI technology.
benefits: Significantly improves discoverability of instrument reference data.
Facilitates intuitive user interaction through natural language processing.
metrics: User satisfaction ratings from metadata access.
Reduction in time spent searching for relevant data products.

outcomes.description: The Metadata Agent allows users to discover data products using natural language queries.
successCriteria: Users can easily access relevant data through the agent.
Natural language queries return semantically relevant results.
measurableResults: Increase in the number of successful searches.

technologies.name: Data Explorer (DEx)
technologies.description: Internal data catalog used to source metadata for the agent.

technologies.name: PG Vector
technologies.description: Database technology utilized for storing and processing vector embeddings for similarity search.

technologies.name: Snowflake
technologies.description: Data warehouse platform used for storing and retrieving instrument reference data.

technologies.name: Python
technologies.description: Programming language used for the development of the Metadata Agent.

technologies.name: Large Language Model (LLM)
technologies.description: AI model used for generating structured answers from user queries.

approach.description: An end-to-end solution designed to facilitate metadata retrieval through user-friendly queries.

plan.name: Metadata Agent Development
plan.description: Creating a metadata agent that enhances data accessibility through AI-driven query processing.

methods.name: Vector Similarity Search Implementation
methods.description: Developing the capability to perform vector similarity searches for natural language queries.
steps: Integrate with LLM for response generation.

tools.name: Jenkins
tools.description: An open-source automation server used to build, test, and deploy software through continuous integration and delivery pipelines.

tools.name: Spinnaker
tools.description: A multi-cloud continuous delivery platform designed for reliable, repeatable, and safe application deployments.

milestones: Completion of metadata extraction and transformation.
Successful integration of vector search functionality.
Deployment of the Metadata Agent for user testing.

team.name: Asset & Wealth Management AI Development Team
team.description: Team responsible for designing and implementing AI systems within the Asset & Wealth Management division.

roles.name: Lead Software Engineer
roles.description: Oversees the project development and ensures alignment with organizational goals.

responsibilities.description: Lead the design and implementation of the Metadata Agent.
